svg.title: Growth of 100,000 dollars: V13.5 versus SPY and QQQ
svg.desc: A line chart comparing the V13.5 booked-equity research proxy with price-only SPY and QQQ buy-and-hold benchmarks from January 2024 through August 2026.
svg.text: Amber bands: QQQ prior-close below its prior 50-session moving average. Benchmarks exclude dividends and fees.
